RdyDeck has four short daily games built from real Pokémon TCG tournament lists. Each one is new every day and the same for every player, so you can compare scores with friends. They are free, need no account and are played on the RdyDeck home screen.

Play today's games

Prize Check

Everyone gets the same decklist and the same shuffle. Six cards go face down as prizes, you flip through the rest of the deck, and you name the six that are missing as fast as you can. It trains prize mapping, the skill of working out your prizes during your first turn. Your first try is your score, and you can share it.

Play today's Prize Check, or drill your own list with the prize trainer.

Quickest Win

A real board built from two top tournament lists. You can win this turn if you find the right line. Your first try is your score.

Play today's Quickest Win.

Rare Pull

Seven prompts, such as "Name a Supporter" or "Name a Basic Pokémon", each for a group of top tournament lists. Pick a card that fits within 30 seconds. The fewer of those top lists run your card, the higher it scores, up to 100 for each prompt. A card counts when at least 1 in 20 of those lists run it, and passing or running out of time scores 0. Rare Pull needs a connection the first time it loads.

Open RdyDeck and tap Rare Pull under Daily Games.

Guess the Grade

A real tournament list, the same for everyone. Study it, then guess the grade RdyDeck gives it out of 10. You get 4 guesses. Each one tells you higher or lower, and Hot (within 0.2), Warm (within 0.5) or Cold. It is a quick way to learn what the deck checker rewards before you grade your own list.

Play today's Guess the Grade.

How the Daily Games Work

  • New each day: the games change at midnight on your device.
  • Same for everyone: every player gets the same list, board or prompts that day.
  • First try counts: your first play is your score. You can replay for practice.
  • Streaks: play on back to back days and the home screen shows your streak.
  • On your device: scores stay in your browser. There is nothing to sign up for.

Questions

Are the daily games free?
Yes. All four are free, need no account and run in your browser on a phone or computer.
Where are the daily games in RdyDeck?
On the home screen, under Daily Games.
When do the daily games reset?
At midnight on your device. A new list, board and set of prompts are ready the next day.
Can I play a daily game again?
Yes. Your first try is your score for the day, and every replay after it is practice.
Do the daily games use real decks?
Yes. Prize Check, Quickest Win and Guess the Grade use real tournament lists, and Rare Pull scores cards by how many top lists run them.

Keep Practicing

The daily games are a few minutes a day. To practice the deck you will actually play, grade it, check its opening odds, drill its prizes in the prize trainer and goldfish its first turns.
